environment: Linux sandboxed headless Chromium and WebKit; fresh synthetic profiles; local source on localhost:8779
playtest: Playtest: touch Resume under forced fine-pointer query must not lock; explicit mouse Resume calls a non-promise request once; pointer-lock error clears movement; settings freeze combat and Escape works from a focused slider; Resume closes settings; fire remaps F→G; native Chromium CDP simultaneous captured touch move/look/fire and cancellation; rotate to 568×320, Resume and check action target reachability.

results.touch: PASS: three trusted native CDP touch pointers captured independently; simultaneous move/look/fire and cancellation
Synthetic coverage remains in the main WebKit suite

limitations: Trusted CDP touch is browser automation, not a physical iPhone test; WebKit simultaneous touch remains synthetic. Resume uses a native mouse click on its checked visible/reachable centre because WebKit locator stability waits can stall after a remap while paused.
